- Bridgebuilder round 2 on PR #1302 — a leading slash is the root anchor (kept by normalisation; `/README.md` names only the root file, `/*.yml` only root-level YAML, `/.reviewignore` is explicit for protection; `./` is still stripped); a negated character class compiles to `[^/…]` so it never matches the path separator; the contents-path validator refuses control characters through `\p{Cc}` instead of a `\^@-\^_` range two review voices misread (sprint 279, lead)
